none: PAS CAM-6BF506: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD335-337
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS] ; D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN N C

A copper alloy Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD335-337 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverseshows Two soldiers, one standard. Mint is unknown. Obverse legend reads: CONSTANTINVS IVN N C. Obverse shows Laureate and cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis is 6 o'clock
